d: A trio of small fairies with pastel-colored hair in shades of platinum blonde, soft mint, and pale peach, all short and wispy. Large, sparkling jewel-toned eyes with a mischievous glint. Apparent age of young children with chubby cheeks. Tiny, diminutive builds. Each wears a simple white shift dress with a different colored ribbon. All three possess small, shimmering gossamer wings and tiny pointed ears. BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
